FACT-2.gloss: Raymond was born 6 years before Samantha

FACT-3.gloss: Raymond's son was born when Raymond was 23 years old

RULE-1.gloss: If y is currently m years old and x was born n years before y, then x was born (m−n) years ago
RULE-1.formula: ∀x∀y∀n∀m ((CurrentAge(y, m) ∧ BornBefore(x, y, n)) → BornYearsAgo(x, m-n))
RULE-1.verify_reason: If x was born n years before y, and y is currently m years old, then x is (m+n) years old, so x was born (m+n) years ago, not (m−n). The rule inverts the correct relationship.

RULE-2.gloss: If x was born n years ago and x's son was born when x was k years old, then x's son was born (n+k) years ago
RULE-2.verify_reason: If x was born n years ago (so x is currently n years old) and x had a son at age k, the son was born (n−k) years ago, not (n+k). The rule uses the wrong operation.

INF-1.gloss: Raymond was born 25 years ago, from FACT-1, FACT-2, and RULE-1 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens (computing 31-6=25)

INF-2.gloss: Raymond's son was born 48 years ago, from INF-1, FACT-3, and RULE-2 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens (computing 25+23=48)
